subject: ela
cluster: Research to build and present knowledge
intro: Pick the best note, grouping, or source idea.

items.prompt:
A good NOTE is:
A) a short record of a key fact in your own words
B) the whole paragraph copied
C) a drawing only
items.answer: A) a short record of a key fact in your own words

steps: Short, own words. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) a short record of a key fact in your own words

items.prompt:
Sorting your notes into groups is called:
A) categorizing
B) printing
C) erasing

A list of where your facts came from is a list of:
A) sources
B) titles
C) colors

Read.

Hummingbirds beat their wings about 50 times per second and can fly backward.

The BEST note is:
A) Hummingbird: ~50 wingbeats/sec, flies backward
B) Hummingbirds are small, pretty birds that live in gardens and drink nectar from many flowers
C) birds

steps: Short, key facts. Key is A.

items.prompt:
Why do researchers LIST their sources?
A) to show where the information came from
B) to make the report heavier
C) to hide the facts
items.answer: A) to show where the information came from

steps: Credit and tracking. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) to show where the information came from

items.prompt:
You have facts about a shark's diet, size, and habitat. Putting them into those three groups is:
A) categorizing
B) copying
C) deleting

steps: Grouping by idea. Key is A.

items.prompt:
Read.

Octopuses have three hearts, blue blood, and can change color to hide.

The BEST note is:
A) Octopus: 3 hearts, blue blood, changes color
B) Octopuses are amazing sea animals that live in the ocean and are very interesting to study
C) sea
items.answer: A) Octopus: 3 hearts, blue blood, changes color

steps: Short, key facts only. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) Octopus: 3 hearts, blue blood, changes color

items.prompt:
You take notes from three websites and a book. For your report you should ALSO:
A) list all four sources
B) pretend you used only one
C) list no sources

steps: List every source used. Key is A.
